decisions.title: Market Data Provider Selection
decisions.recommendation: Tiingo Power (/mo) for offline daily bar research; Alpaca AlgoTrader Plus (/mo) for paper order routing.

decisions.title: Market Data Licensing and Rights
decisions.recommendation: REMAINS STRICTLY BLOCKED. Commercial non-display addenda and data purge architecture required.

decisions.title: Statistical Endpoint and Inferential Protocol
decisions.recommendation: Exploratory observational comparison endorsed; confirmatory superiority rejected due to small-sample size distortion.

decisions.title: Evaluation Horizon and Stopping Rules
decisions.recommendation: Inverse sampling quota design (minimum N_def >= 30, baseline 252 sessions, maximum 504 sessions).

decisions.title: Monitoring and Incident Governance
decisions.recommendation: Automated circuit breaker tripwires verified offline; physical latency benchmark pending authorization.

decisions.title: Activation Authority
decisions.recommendation: PERMANENT SAFETY BARRIER. Prospective live and paper execution remain strictly unauthorized.
